name: Pane
text: Pane: Light mode’s high contrast solves visibility but ignores the core problem—glare isn’t just bright, it’s *unpredictable*. A one-click toggle still demands user action in the worst moment, and dark mode’s comfort in low light is useless if users don’t switch until after they’ve squinted at a washed-out screen. Settle it with an *auto-adjusting* theme that shifts contrast based on ambient light, not user whims—then measure error rates and task speed in both extremes.
